summary: The apparent body-width implementation is geometrically defensible, rotation-tested, calibrated in XY, selected from the largest valid observed mask plane, and separated from explicitly labelled legacy EDT width. Acceptance is blocked because total_3d_length_um is presented in tables, reports, figures, and study comparisons as a 3D/geodesic nucleus length, but its formula is only the hypotenuse of the maximum single-plane 2D centerline length and endpoint Z span. It neither reconstructs nor integrates a 3D centerline. The generic volume_um3 field similarly aliases an observed-slice slab sum and is displayed as “3D Volume,” which overstates its geometric meaning.

findings.title: Reported 3D geodesic length is not a reconstructed 3D geodesic
findings.impact: Orientation, curvature, changing in-plane centerlines, lateral motion, and missing planes can produce the same maximum 2D length and endpoint Z span but different physical 3D arc lengths. Consequently, total_3d_length_um and every table, figure, ratio, or specimen summary using it do not establish the stated 3D/geodesic nucleus length.

findings.title: Observed-slice slab sum is generically reported as 3D volume
findings.impact: The value is defensible as sampled observed-mask slab volume, but volume_um3 and “3D Volume” can be interpreted as an interpolated or reconstructed physical nucleus volume. Gaps contribute no mask while each observed plane contributes a full Z-spacing slab, so the quantity is acquisition- and sampling-dependent.

findings.title: No known-curved-3D synthetic test protects the primary track-length meaning
findings.impact: The existing track test confirms the current hypotenuse formula rather than validating the claimed geometric meaning, so substantial orientation and curvature bias can pass automated validation.

findings.recommendation: Add anisotropic synthetic tracks with straight oblique, curved, rotating, single-slice, missing-plane, and reversed-order cases. Assert the intended field against analytic geometry and assert that projection, centroid-trajectory, and reconstructed-centerline quantities remain separately named.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as required by the review instructions.
Focused pytest execution was unavailable because pytest is not installed in the accessible Python environment; test source was inspected read-only.
This review did not inspect other reviewers' outputs.
Apparent body width does not establish PSF-corrected chromatin diameter, molecular width, or biological abnormality.
Observed-mask slab volume does not establish anatomical seminal-vesicle volume or a fully reconstructed nucleus volume.
Measurements alone do not establish a WT-versus-mutant effect; independent specimens are the inferential units.
recommended_follow_up: Correct or rename total_3d_length_um and update every dependent report and study field before a superseding audit run.
Qualify the observed-mask volume consistently in CSV schemas, PDFs, plots, and study summaries.
Run the focused synthetic measurement suite in the locked production environment and archive its command, dependency identity, and output.
Add analytic adversarial tests for curved anisotropic 3D geometry, missing planes, orientation changes, and field-name compatibility.
